svg.text: - filled dot at an edge's child end = mandatory feature
- hollow dot at the child end = optional feature
- [xor] on a parent = alternative group (choose exactly one)
- [or] on a parent = or-group (choose one or more)
- plain line (no dot) = a member of an xor/or group
Colours: blue = mandatory core, green = optional seam,
purple = sub-feature, white = concrete option (a config 'kind')
- ensemble_measure applies only when UQ = ensemble
- Persona = Capability x Visibility x Trust.
- Service Time composes optional scale / fatigue wrappers.
